summary: Brock and Matteo simultaneously discover they are both pursuing Élodie. Smoothie diplomacy and an eight-course revenge risotto escalate into the villa's first international incident, while Élodie rates both suitors a five. A torch-lit twist ends day one: Spain has entered the villa — for Élodie.
unresolvedStorylines: Who will Élodie actually rate above a five?
Matteo vs Brock rivalry is now open
continuityNotes: Series premiere — plants the triangle, the rivalry, and Alejandro's arrival.
